classification.difficultyReason: Apply the taught even and odd symmetry transformations to supplied branches, preserving marked points and curve shape; the required symmetry is specified for every completion.

content.prompt:
In each diagram below, complete the graph of $y=f(x)$ so that $f(x)$ is

i even

ii odd.

spec.description: Upper semicircular arch from (0,0) to (2,0), with peak (1,1), on axes extending into both half-planes. Guides mark the peak.
spec.mathematics: Given arch has centre (1,0), radius 1, and y≥0.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied right-hand arch is visible.

answer.short: Add the reflection of the arch in the $y$-axis.
answer.worked: For an even function, $f(-x)=f(x)$. Reflect each given point using $(x,y)\mapsto(-x,y)$. The added arch passes through $(-2,0)$, $(-1,1)$ and $(0,0)$.

spec.description: Two upper arches symmetric about the y-axis.
Duplicate of the supplied arch for the independent odd completion.

answer.short: Add the image of the arch after a $180^\circ$ rotation about the origin.
answer.worked: For an odd function, $f(-x)=-f(x)$. Use $(x,y)\mapsto(-x,-y)$. The added lower arch passes through $(-2,0)$, $(-1,-1)$ and $(0,0)$.

spec.description: Upper right and lower left arches with origin symmetry.
spec.mathematics: Peaks of magnitude 1 occur at x=±1; endpoints at x=±2 and 0.

spec.description: Upper-left branch through (-1,1), ending at the origin, with an outward arrow.
spec.mathematics: A schematic branch parameterised by (-t²,t), t≥0, reproduces the supplied shape and marked point. No equation is printed for students.

answer.short: Reflect the branch in the $y$-axis, adding a branch through $(1,1)$.
answer.worked: Use $f(-x)=f(x)$ and reflect $(x,y)\mapsto(-x,y)$. The two upper branches meet at the origin.

spec.description: Two upward branches meeting at the origin, reflected in the y-axis.
Duplicate given branch for the independent odd completion.

answer.short: Rotate the branch $180^\circ$ about the origin, adding a branch through $(1,-1)$.
answer.worked: Use $f(-x)=-f(x)$ and map $(x,y)\mapsto(-x,-y)$. The new lower-right branch meets the given branch at the origin.

spec.description: Upper-left and lower-right branches with origin symmetry.
Right-hand parabolic branch through (0,0), (1,-1) and (2,0), with an upper-right arrow.
spec.mathematics: Right-hand branch represented by y=x²−2x, x≥0.

answer.short: Reflect the given branch in the $y$-axis.
answer.worked: Use $(x,y)\mapsto(-x,y)$. The added branch has a minimum at $(-1,-1)$ and an $x$-intercept at $(-2,0)$.

spec.description: Even completion with two minima and both ends rising.
Duplicate given branch for the independent odd completion.

answer.short: Rotate the given branch $180^\circ$ about the origin.
answer.worked: Use $(x,y)\mapsto(-x,-y)$. The added branch has a maximum at $(-1,1)$ and an $x$-intercept at $(-2,0)$.

spec.description: Odd completion with left maximum and right minimum.
